text:
kai: Dropping notes from design sync — need decisions so eng can scope. Short checklist:
1) Guardrail label: 'Recommended cap' vs 'Safety cap' for default wording?
2) Burst pill: absolute vs percent precedence + mobile behavior.
3) Pool picker keyboard trap (virtualized list).
4) Min/Max helper copy and aria-live for SRs.

rachel: Leaning towards 'Recommended cap' for default — less scary for new users. We can surface stronger language in admin docs.

david: Burst pill rule proposal: <=5 GPUs show absolute primary, 6-20 show absolute + muted percent, >20 show percent primary with muted absolute on hover. Mobile: single-line compact (percent preferred).

sylvia: Accessibility: orange guardrail marker fails AA at 12px. Recommend darker #8A4C00 and a 2px focus ring. Add aria-live region: "Min set to X GPUs. Max set to Y GPUs. Guardrail recommended at Z GPUs." Also ensure roving tabindex for pool picker so Tab/Esc break out.

kai: Good. Rachel — can you write the two-line helper copy for min/max and guardrail? Keep sentences simple for translations.

rachel: Draft microcopy:
Min: Minimum GPUs kept online to meet latency targets.
Max: Upper bound for scale during spikes; may increase cost.
Guardrail (recommended): Helps keep traffic within SLO; excess may be routed to fallback capacity.

david: Microcopy nit: change 'may be routed' -> 'may route to fallback capacity' (shorter). Also add tiny keyboard hint under pool picker: '\u2191\u2193 preview \u2022 Enter select \u2022 Esc close'.

sylvia: Confirming: implement aria-activedescendant + roving tabindex for listbox so SR announces focused pool. Also add aria-describedby on sparkline and guardrail for non-visual summary. I'll file ACC ticket.

a11y-bot: Logged ACC-6123: autoscale-guardrail-contrast + ACC-6124: pool-picker-roving-tabindex. Links: https://tracker.redwood/ACC-6123 https://tracker.redwood/ACC-6124

kai: I'll update figma with the adaptive burst rules and the copy. David - please add analytics events: burst_pill_hover, guardrail_info_open, pool_picker_hint_shown. Sylvia - please validate SR announcements after prototype update.

david: Will do. Created INF-4010 for analytics.

kai: Thanks — I'll post updated frames and re-open thread. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
